（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 6748 Date. 28 / 6 / 35）

Statement Of
Tientsin A-O
Bank Issued

Northern Branch Shown
To Be In Better Con-
dition Than Parent
Institution; Loans Less

Cash On Hand, $57,000;
Deposits, $1,497,076

That the Tientsin branch of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation was in better position than the Shanghai bank is reflected in a statement issued yesterday afternoon by Mr. Frank L. Hough, liquidator of the bank and other Raven interests now in liquidation.

For one thing, there was more cash on hand, the total for cash and cash items being $57,591.47. The loans and overdrafts totaled only $1,299,762.85. Inasmuch as yesterday's statement shows the bank position at the close of business on May 23, Mr. Hough is of the opinion that the figure for loans and overdrafts will probably prove much lower when deeper examination is made into the affairs of the branch.

The total book resources of the branch on May 23 are placed at $2,162,192.12, while the total liabilities, including deposits, amount $1,853,159.65. Deposits amount to $1,497,076.76.

North Branch More Liquid

Although the figure listed under cash and cash items is $57,591.47, it is not yet known just how much of this sum was actual cash. In the local bank statement, the sum stated was a little more than $17,-000 and upon further investigation, it was discovered that the actual amount of cash was not much more than $7,000 and that a considerable portion of the cash items listed old American-Oriental bank-notes, out of circulation and worthless, which were still carried on the books of the corporation. It is believed, however, that the Tientsin branch will show a much better record for cold, hard cash than the Shanghai concern.

While the statement on the affairs of the Tientsin branch shows a better position than that which existed in Shanghai when the corporation closed its doors, the fact still remains that $57,-591.47 in cash and cash items is a very small amount for a bank to have on hand, even though its deposits are only approximately a million and a half, it was pointed out.

美亚银行天津分行
发布声明

显示北区分行状况优于
总行机构；贷款较少

手头现金57,000美元；
存款1,497,076美元

美亚银行公司及其他正在清算的雷文（Raven）利益相关方的清算人弗兰克·L·豪夫先生昨日下午发布的一份声明反映出，美亚银行天津分行的处境优于上海总行。

一方面，手头现金较多，现金及现金项目总额为57,591.47美元。贷款和透支总额仅为1,299,762.85美元。鉴于昨日的声明显示的是5月23日营业结束时的银行状况，豪夫先生认为，随着对分行事务的深入审查，贷款和透支的数字可能会证明要低得多。

5月23日，该分行的账面资源总额为2,162,192.12美元，而包括存款在内的负债总额为1,853,159.65美元。存款金额为1,497,076.76美元。

北区分行流动性更强

虽然列在现金及现金项目下的数字为57,591.47美元，但目前尚不清楚其中有多少是实际现金。在上海本地的银行声明中，所述金额略高于17,000美元，经进一步调查发现，实际现金金额不超过7,000美元，且列出的现金项目中相当一部分是已停止流通且毫无价值的旧美亚银行钞票，但这些仍挂在公司的账上。然而，人们相信，天津分行在手头硬通货方面的记录将比上海机构好得多。

尽管关于天津分行事务的声明显示其状况优于该公司关门时上海的状况，但有人指出，事实仍然是，即使存款仅约为150万，57,591.47美元的现金及现金项目对于一家银行来说也是极少的手头资金。

S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D _______
Date ___/___/___

THE LIQUIDATION
Mr. F. L. Hough's caustic statement regarding the progress of the collec-tions under the liquidation of the American-Oriental Banking Corpora-tion makes unpleasant reading. Due allowance will at once be forthcoming for those debtors who are so placed that they cannot immediately meet their liabilities. They have a clear course of action which some of them have taken—in a frank statement to the Liquidator who doubtless will take all the relevant facts into con-sideration in tempering the wind to the shorn lamb. There are obviously others—who are trying to evade their responsibilities in the hope that by some means or other they may stave off the evil day of repayment or make a profitable bargain with the Liquida-tor. Mr. Hough is standing no non-sense and he will have the warm support of all the Bank's unfortunate creditors in the firm legal action which he proposes to initiate next week in order to bring these debtors to a proper realization of their re-sponsibilities. Incidentally the state-ment, taken in conjunction with the figures already made public, throws a queer light on the confident assur-ances given at the time of the Bank's closure. Mr. Hough has evidently a heavy task ahead of him, but he is showing the right spirit of deter-mination. Creditors must feel that when the full implications of the failure have been revealed, appro-priate measures will follow.

F. L. Hough（豪夫）先生关于美亚银行（American-Oriental Banking Corporation）清算过程中收款进展的尖锐言论，读来令人不悦。对于那些处境困难、无法立即偿还债务的债务人，自当予以通融。他们有一条明确的行动路径，其中一些人也已采取——即向清算人坦诚陈述，后者无疑会在“量体裁衣”时充分考虑所有相关事实。显然还有另一些人——他们试图逃避责任，希望以某种方式拖延还款的厄运之日，或与清算人达成有利可图的交易。豪夫先生不容胡闹，他将获得该银行所有不幸债权人的热烈支持，对他拟于下周启动的坚定法律行动给予支持，以使这些债务人适当认识到其责任。顺便提一句，结合已公布的数字来看，这份声明使该银行关闭时所给出的自信保证显得颇为怪异。豪夫先生显然面临艰巨任务，但他正展现出正确的决心精神。债权人必须感到，当破产的全部影响被揭示后，将会采取适当的措施。

Only Meagre Collection
Of Loans, Overdrafts And
Debts Owed To Raven Cos.

Liquidator Hough Issues First Statement After
Fortnight's Working And Expresses Extreme
Dissatisfaction; A Cash Discrepancy

COURT ACTIONS THREATENED IF MORE
DEBTORS DO NOT RESPOND

Fresh light was shed on the condition of affairs of the
American-Oriental Banking Corporation, the American-
Oriental Finance Corporation and the Raven Trust Com-
pany in statements issued yesterday by the Liquidator, Mr.
Frank L. Hough, showing the amount of the collections he
has succeeded in making during the two weeks ended June
18. All loans, overdrafts and other debts due to the Bank
and its affiliates were called by the Liquidator on June 4,
yet the response, as the figures show, has been meagre in
the extreme.

Loans and overdrafts due to the
American-Oriental Banking Corp-
oration, according to the books of
the Bank, amounted to $6,775,435.-
73, exclusive of the amounts due
by the affiliate concerns. Of this
total, the Liquidator has succeeded
in collecting only $32,449.62, or
roughly one-half of 1 per cent.
Further collections have been
made under other headings, bring-
ing the total amount realized in
the two-week period up to $89,-
782.80.
Actual cash found in the Bank
vault amounted to $13,527.72, as
compared with $17,541.19, the sum
shown in the books as being on
hand on May 23, the last day on
which the Bank was open for busi-
ness. The approximate difference
of $4,000, the Liquidator states, is
represented by "worthless circula-
tion" found in the vault but carried
in the books as an asset. This
"worthless circulation," Mr. Hough
informed the press, consisted of
banknotes of the American-
Oriental Banking Corporation it-
self, which had been out of circula-
tion for some considerable time
prior to the Bank's closure.

Finance Corporation
In the case of the American-
Oriental Finance Corporation, the
Liquidator has succeeded, according
to his statement, in collecting
$4,166.92 of the $178,749.50 due
from correspondents. As regards
the Raven Trust Company, collec-
tions on loans have reached a round
$2,000 out of a total due amount-
ing to $226,902.82.
Extreme dissatisfaction with the
rate at which monies are coming
in was expressed by Mr. Hough
yesterday. The Liquidator has
a staff of about 35 working on the
liquidations, and as he expressed
it, there is not much more than
enough coming in to meet current
expenses, which are being kept
down to a minimum.

Court Actions
"I intend to take immediate
action to liquidate their indebtedness. In
cases where we get no response we
will be obliged to take recourse to
legal action for recovery. We in-
tend doing that without delay." -

收回的美亚银行及雷文公司
贷款、透支和欠款寥寥无几

清算人豪夫在工作两周后发布首份声明，表示极度不满；现金出现差额

若更多债务人不回应，将威胁采取法律诉讼

清算人弗兰克·L·豪夫（Frank L. Hough）先生昨日发布的声明，为美亚银行（American-Oriental Banking Corporation）、美亚金融公司（American-Oriental Finance Corporation）和雷文信托公司（Raven Trust Company）的事务状况提供了新的线索，显示他在截至6月18日的两周内成功收回的款项金额。清算人已于6月4日催缴欠该银行及其关联公司的所有贷款、透支和其他债务，然而正如数字所示，回应极其微薄。

根据银行账簿，欠美亚银行的贷款和透支总额为6,775,435.73美元，不包括关联公司所欠金额。在此总额中，清算人仅成功收回32,449.62美元，约占百分之零点五。在其他项目下也有进一步收款，使这两周内的实收总额达到89,782.80美元。

银行金库中实际发现的现金为13,527.72美元，而账簿显示的5月23日（银行营业的最后一天）手头现金为17,541.19美元。清算人称，约4,000美元的差额代表在金库中发现但在账簿上作为资产列示的“无价值流通券”。豪夫先生告知新闻界，这种“无价值流通券”由美亚银行自身的钞票组成，这些钞票在银行关闭前相当长一段时间内已停止流通。

金融公司

就美亚金融公司而言，根据其声明，清算人成功从往来账户欠款中收回了178,749.50美元中的4,166.92美元。至于雷文信托公司，在总计226,902.82美元的到期贷款中，收回金额约为2,000美元。

豪夫先生昨日对资金回笼速度表示了极度不满。清算人拥有约35名员工从事清算工作，正如他所言，收入仅勉强够支付当前开支，且开支已降至最低限度。

法律诉讼

“我打算立即采取行动清算他们的债务。在我们得不到回应的情况下，我们将不得不诉诸法律手段进行追讨。我们打算毫不拖延地这样做。” -

Court Action Is Planned
Against A.O.-Bank Debtors

Preparation of court actions
against debtors of the American-
Oriental Banking Corporation who
show no inclination to effect a set-
tlement is likely to start next week
"unless there's a sudden deluge of
money coming in," it was indicated
today by Mr. Frank L. Hough,
liquidator.

Indications to date point to
drought rather than flood in that
respect, it is understood.

"Many of the people with loans
and overdrafts have been hammer-
ed plenty already, so they're case-
hardened," Mr. Hough commented.
"We don't like to act in court but
we certainly shall when and where
it is necessary. I already have a
pretty good idea of the main prob-
abilities."

Either tomorrow or Friday a
second statement, which Mr. Hough
promises will be "extremely inter-
esting," is to be given out by the
liquidator and this expected to be
highly enlightening as to details of
the bank's position. The first state-
ment merely gave the book show-
ing as of the day of closing.

Debtors of the bank take in many
nationalities but it is believed that
the majority are American so it is
likely that the bulk of the suits
will be filed in the U.S. Court for
China.

Premises of the bank in Tientsin
have been taken over by Mr. Harry
A. Lucker and Mr. Emil S. Fischer,
who has been appointed Tientsin
representative of Mr. Henry De-

audit, has started an audit of the

计划对美亚银行债务人采取法律行动

除非“突然有大量资金涌入”，否则针对那些无意和解的美亚银行债务人准备提起诉讼的工作可能将于下周开始，清算人弗兰克·L·豪夫先生今日表示。

据了解，目前的迹象表明，在这方面是干旱而非洪涝。

“许多有贷款和透支的人已经受够了敲打，所以他们已经变得麻木不仁，”豪夫先生评论道。“我们不喜欢诉诸法庭，但在必要的时候和地点，我们肯定会这样做。我对主要的可能性已经有了相当好的了解。”

明天或周五，清算人将发布第二份声明，豪夫先生承诺该声明将“极其有趣”，预计将对银行状况的细节提供高度启发。第一份声明仅给出了关闭当日的账面情况。

该银行的债务人涉及多种国籍，但据信大多数是美国人，因此大部分诉讼很可能将在美国驻华法院提起。

天津的银行旧址已由哈里·A·卢克（Harry A. Lucker）先生和埃米尔·S·费舍尔（Emil S. Fischer）先生接管，后者被任命为亨利·德沃尔特（Henry Devault）先生的天津代表，德沃尔特先生目前正在进行上海方面的审计，他已与卢克先生一起开始对天津分行进行审计。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SATURDAY, JUNE 15, 1935

RARE COLLECTION
OF OLD COINS IN
A.-O. BANK VAULT

Only Cash Currency Found:
Face Value of $7,389

BIG DEBTORS PAYING
LIABILITIES SLOWLY

A rare collection of old coins, of the face value of $7,389.65, was disclosed as the entire cash currency assets on hand when the liquidator opened the vaults of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation at 29 Nanking Road. This collection included sen pieces, Hongkong dollars, U.S. ten-cent pieces, various other foreign money, and slightly more than 1,000 silver dollars. Approximately $10,000 worth of cheques for collection made up the remainder of the $17,541.19 in cash and cash items listed as assets by the bank on its books.

The above interesting disclosure was made by Mr. Frank L. Hough, the liquidator appointed by the U.S. Court, yesterday afternoon, who said that the funds now repose in a special liquidator's account at the Chase Bank.

Following the publication of the statement of the Raven companies assets and liabilities, Mr. Hough stated that he had received numerous telephone calls and that the general concensus of opinion expressed was that "the situation seemed even worse than it had looked before." He added:-"I am now getting down to the cold facts, and I don't care about the romance of how it happened. I just want to know how much money we can realize on outstanding loans and what we are going to do."

Mr. Hough intimated that some of the items listed as assets on the bank's books were "not worth a nickel," and that many should be removed as assets.

Sitting at his desk in his shirt-sleeves, Mr. Hough declared that he had spent a busy day sending chits to the bank's debtors, trying to realize cash on outstanding loans. He stated that the smaller debtors who owed in the neighbourhood of between four and five thousand dollars were paying in full at once, although those who owed the bank sums as large as $50,000 were paying as little as $5,000 on account.

Even as he talked, he received a cheque for $6,000 from one debtor. He told an interesting tale of a Shanghai missionary whose entire life savings were in the bank, and who also had an overdraft of $9,000.

"Although this man was going home on his first long leave in 15 years and had children at home in college, he insisted on paying us the amount of the overdraft before his departure. It simply means that this man must start all over again."

The liquidator announced that only small salaried employees of the three bankrupt companies had received salaries. Department heads must wait until money is available, and officers must wait until the very last. "Employees," he said, "will be paid 100 per cent. the first of all, according to their legal rights."

"We are getting a real and legal picture of the situation now that the bank's books have been closed, and we are expending all our energies in getting in as much cash as possible," said Mr. Hough in pointing

out that the money is pretty well out in loans. He also pointed out that the bank building is owned by the Asia Realty Company and the bank has a mortgage on it. He estimated that this particular piece of property should bring in at least one million dollars.

Mr. Hough and his staff, which includes Mr. Henry S. De Vault, auditor, and the latter's assistants, now are checking securities. As soon as this is worked down to condensed form, Mr. Hough said that the liquidator's offices would be moved from the bank premises.

《字林西报》，1935年6月15日，星期六

美亚银行金库中
罕见的古币收藏

仅发现现钞货币：
面值7,389美元

大债务人缓慢偿还债务

当清算人打开位于南京路29号的美亚银行金库时，披露其手头全部现金资产为一套面值为7,389.65美元的罕见古币收藏。这套收藏包括分币、香港银元、美国一角硬币、各种其他外币以及略多于1,000枚的银元。约价值10,000美元的待收支票构成了银行账簿上列为资产的17,541.19美元现金及现金项目的其余部分。

这一有趣的披露是由美国法院任命的清算人弗兰克·L·豪夫先生于昨日下午作出的，他说这笔资金现在存放在大通银行（Chase Bank）的一个特别清算人账户中。

在公布雷文公司资产负债声明后，豪夫先生表示他接到了许多电话，普遍表达的意见是“情况似乎比以前看起来更糟”。他补充说：“我现在正在处理冷酷的事实，我不关心事情发生的浪漫故事。我只想知道我们能从未偿贷款中变现多少钱，以及我们要做什么。”

豪夫先生暗示，银行账簿上列为资产的一些项目“一文不值”，许多项目应作为资产移除。

豪夫先生穿着衬衫袖子坐在办公桌前，宣称他忙碌了一天，向银行债务人发送便条，试图从未偿贷款中变现现金。他表示，欠款在四五千美元左右的小额债务人正在全额立即付款，而那些欠银行高达5万美元的人则仅支付5,000美元作为部分还款。

就在他谈话时，他收到了一位债务人开出的6,000美元支票。他讲述了一个关于上海传教士的有趣故事，这位传教士的全部积蓄都存在该银行，并且还有9,000美元的透支。

“虽然这个人正要回家享受15年来的第一次长假，而且家里有孩子在上大学，但他坚持在出发前向我们支付透支金额。这仅仅意味着这个人必须从头再来。”

清算人宣布，只有这三家破产公司的小薪职员收到了薪水。部门主管必须等到有钱可用，而高级职员必须等到最后。“员工，”他说，“将根据其合法权利，百分之百地首先得到支付。”

“既然银行账簿已经关闭，我们现在得到了局势的真实和法律图景，我们正在倾注全部精力尽可能多地收回现金，”豪夫先生在指出资金大部分都在贷款中时说道。他还指出，银行大楼由亚洲地产公司（Asia Realty Company）拥有，银行对其设有抵押权。他估计这块特定财产至少能带来一百万美元的收入。

豪夫先生及其团队，其中包括审计师亨利·S·德沃尔特（Henry S. De Vault）先生及其助手，目前正在核对证券。豪夫先生说，一旦这项工作浓缩完成，清算人办公室将从银行旧址搬出。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, SATURDAY, JUNE 15, 1935.

Depositors Amazed At Cash
Shortage In A.-O. Bank

Work Involved In Detailed Audit Will Take Con-
siderable Time, Liquidator Asserts; Thorough
Checking Is Now Necessitated

Depositors and others whose funds are tied up in the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, the American-Oriental Finance Corporation and the Raven Trust Company were unpleasantly shocked by the revelation yesterday of the position of the affairs of the three Raven Companies, Mr. Frank L. Hough, liquidator, informed press representatives yesterday. As Mr. Hough phrased it: "They thought the position was bad, but not that bad."
Mr. Hough revealed that following publication of the financial statements of the three companies, he had been the recipient of numerous telephone calls from interested inquirers who are as ever to get some idea as what it will be possible to salvage from the recent shipwreck of the Raven interests.
The work of a detailed audit, requiring the thorough checking and valuation of assets, has now been embarked upon, Mr. Hough said. But the true position of the companies, as reflected in audited balance sheets, will not be known for at least another two months. The financial statements published yesterday merely reflect the position of the Raven companies according to their own books at the date of their closure on May 24.
Small Sum In Currency
In the statement of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation cash on hand at the date of closing was shown as amounting to $17,541.19. But it now transpires that actual currency found in the vaults of the Bank amounted to only $7,389.65. The remaining $10,000 was in cheques, payment of which was stopped in many cases by the drawers when they heard of the bank crash. Mr. Hough said he was now collecting on these cheques.
Progress is also being made, Mr. Hough revealed, in the collection of outstanding loans. Persons and firms with relatively small overdrafts, he said, were proving to be the best payers.
When the preliminary work in connection with the liquidation has been carried through, and the whole job reduced to more manageable proportions, Mr. Hough plans to remove the offices of the liquidator from the premises the offices of the involved concerns at 29 Nanking Road to much cheaper premises.
The Raven building, he said, is owned by the Asia Realty Company. The building, together with the land on which it stands, is understood to be valued at over $1,000,000.

《字林西报》，1935年6月15日，星期六。

存款人惊愕于美亚银行现金短缺

清算人称，详细审计工作耗时甚久；目前亟需进行全面核查

美亚银行（American-Oriental Banking Corporation）、美亚金融公司（American-Oriental Finance Corporation）以及雷文信托公司（Raven Trust Company）的存款人及其他资金被困于上述机构的人士，昨日获悉这三家雷文系公司的财务状况后，感到震惊与不快。清算人弗兰克·L·霍夫（Frank L. Hough）先生昨日向新闻界代表如是说。用霍夫先生的话来说：“他们原以为情况糟糕，但没料到竟如此糟糕。”

霍夫先生透露，在三家公司的财务报表公布后，他接到了许多相关问询者的电话，这些人士迫切希望了解能从近期雷文系利益的“沉船”事故中挽回多少损失。

霍夫先生称，目前已着手开展详细审计工作，需要对资产进行彻底核查与估值。但是，反映在经审计资产负债表中的公司真实状况，至少还需两个月方能知晓。昨日公布的财务报表仅反映了雷文系各公司按其自身账册记录的、截至5月24日停业之日的财务状况。

库存现钞数额微小

在美亚银行的报表中，截止停业日的手头现金显示为17,541.19美元。但如今事实表明，银行金库内实际发现的现钞仅为7,389.65美元。其余10,000美元为支票，其中许多支票的出票人在听闻银行倒闭消息后已停止支付。霍夫先生表示，他目前正在追收这些支票款项。

霍夫先生还透露，在收回未偿贷款方面也取得了进展。他说，那些透支额度相对较小的个人和商行，被证明是最优质的还款者。

待与清算相关的初步工作完成，并将整体事务缩减至更易于管理的规模后，霍夫先生计划将清算人办公室从涉案机构位于南京路29号的办公处所，迁至租金更为低廉的处所。

他说，雷文大楼归亚洲地产公司（Asia Realty Company）所有。据悉，该大楼连同其占地皮产，估值超过100万美元。

A.O. BANK FIGURES ARE MADE PUBLIC

Resources of $11,376,437, Liabilities $7,772,407:
Capital Stock Outstanding $2,575,301

THE OFFICIAL ACCOUNTANT'S SUMMARY

With only the terse comment that they were not the liquidator's idea of conditions, but merely what the books showed at the close of business on May 23, 1935, Mr. Frank L. Hough, liquidator for the Raven companies appointed by the U.S. Court for China, late last night issued statements concerning assets and liabilities of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, American-Oriental Finance Corporation and the Raven Trust Company. The statements, long-awaited by depositors, shareholders and the Shanghai public in general, and compiled by Mr. Henry S. De Vault, certified public accountant, reveal many interesting figures which will be gone over with a fine tooth-comb by Mr. Hough, the auditor, and his staff.

The resources of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, according to the books, total $11,376,-437.76, while liabilities are listed at $7,772,407.69 with capital stock outstanding at $2,575,301.19.

At a quick glance at resources listed in the statement given in full below, students of finance may grasp the rather important point, i.e., the resources show a sum of nearly $1,900,000 is owed to the bank by associated companies but no details are given concerning the $6,-775,435.73 owed by "others." This is interesting in view of the fact that the associated companies by their own request for liquidation are known to be in difficulties and what may be reclaimed from "others" is unknown until further details can be produced.

The statement also brings to light that other resources include a sum of $113,210.49 due from the comprador, $45,276.54 in accounts receivable and $17,541.19 in cash and cash items. Furniture and fixtures, listed as resources, total $114,623.95.

These figures now must be gone through in detail and each item investigated thoroughly, Mr. Hough declared last night. A revaluation will have to be made in many cases, the liquidator said, and some of the questions he will have to answer will be:-

美国驻华法院任命的雷文（Raven）各公司清算人弗兰克·L·霍夫（Frank L. Hough）先生于昨夜深夜发布了关于美亚银行（American-Oriental Banking Corporation）、美亚金融公司（American-Oriental Finance Corporation）及雷文信托公司（Raven Trust Company）资产与负债的声明。他仅简短评论称，这些数据并非清算人对现状的看法，而仅仅是1935年5月23日营业结束时账簿所显示的内容。这些声明由注册会计师亨利·S·德沃尔特（Henry S. De Vault）先生编制，存款人、股东及上海公众已期待已久，其中披露了许多有趣的数据，霍夫先生及其审计团队将对此进行细致审查。

根据账簿记载，美亚银行的资产总额为11,376,437.76美元，负债列为7,772,407.69美元，流通股本为2,575,301.19美元。

声明还揭示，其他资产包括买办欠款113,210.49美元，应收账款45,276.54美元，以及现金和现金项目17,541.19美元。列为资产的家具和设备总计114,623.95美元。

June 13, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post (official organ of Gen. Chiang Kai Shek)
publishes the following comment on June 13, 1935:-

THE CONFIDENCE OF CHINESE PEOPLE IN FOREIGN BANKS

Chinese people seem to have every confidence
in foreign banks and hold the view that they are most
reliable because the banks are provided with adequate
funds.
We do not hold foreigners in contempt nor
are we praising Chinese banks. During the past ten
years, many foreign banks have closed. Recently the
American-Oriental Banking Corporation went out of business.
The closing of these banks caused heavy losses to the
Chinese people.
Foreign banks are not subject to supervision
by the Chinese Government. Most of the foreign banks
which went out of business had failed to refund deposits
in full.
The Chinese people should revise their ideas
of the reliability of foreign banks, and place more
confidence in Chinese banks. As a matter of fact,
most of the Chinese banks possess adequate funds and
are trustworthy. The Chinese people should deposit
their money in Chinese banks as an act of patriotism.
This will benefit the Chinese people as well as the nation.

Sin Wan Pao publishes the following comment :-

THE U.S. STATE SECRETARY'S RECENT SPEECH.

Recently Mr. Cordell Hull, Secretary of State
of America, delivered a speech denouncing those nations
which glorified their military achievement. Mr. Hull
said that the tendency of "some nations" to glorify
military power or for military authorities to assume
the direction of their respective foreign policies in
the world would be a prelude to a universal conflagration
similar to the world war.
What is meant by "certain nations"? Mr.
Hull was undoubtedly hinting at some one.
To speak the truth, Mr. Hull's speech is
nothing but "upbraiding of others in the next room".
The party reproached may not hear the remarks or if
he does, it will not give rise to any feeling. The
world is well aware that the glorification of military
power is a menace to world peace and the world has
been patiently watching the situation from the beginning
to the end, without daring to apportion the blame and
a section is even resorting to flattery to appease the
parties who are glorifying military power.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (12/6):

COMMEMORATION OF THE SUFFERINGS OF SUN YAT SEN IN CANTON

June 18 being the anniversary of the
commemoration of the sufferings endured by the late
Dr. Sun Yat Sen following the defeat of his armies in
Canton by General Chen Chuin Ming in 1922, the local
Tangpu will hold a commemoration meeting at 9 a.m. on
that day at its headquarters.

《上海晨报》（蒋介石将军的官方喉舌）于1935年6月13日发表如下评论：-

中国民众对外国银行的信任

中国民众似乎对外国银行充满信任，并认为这些银行最为可靠，因为它们拥有充足的资金。
我们并非蔑视外国人，也并非在赞扬中国银行。在过去十年中，许多外国银行已经关闭。近期，美亚银行（American-Oriental Banking Corporation）停业。这些银行的关闭给中国民众造成了巨大损失。
外国银行不受中国政府的监管。大多数已停业的外国银行未能全额退还存款。
中国民众应修正其关于外国银行可靠性的观念，并对中国银行给予更多信任。事实上，大多数中国银行拥有充足的资金且值得信赖。中国民众应将钱存入中国银行，以此作为爱国之举。这将有利于中国民众以及国家。

《新闻报》发表如下评论：-

美国国务卿最近的演讲。

近日，美国国务卿科德尔·赫尔（Cordell Hull）先生发表演讲，谴责那些 glorify（颂扬）其军事成就的国家。赫尔先生表示，“某些国家”颂扬军事力量或军事当局主导各自外交政策的倾向，将成为类似世界大战的全面战火的前奏。
所谓“某些国家”是指什么？赫尔先生无疑是在暗示某一方。
说实话，赫尔先生的演讲不过是“隔墙责骂”。被指责的一方可能听不到这些言论，或者即使听到了，也不会产生任何感触。世界深知颂扬军事力量是对世界和平的威胁，世人一直耐心地从头到尾观望局势，不敢分担指责，甚至有一部分人采取奉承手段来安抚那些颂扬军事力量的各方。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸（6月12日）：

在广州纪念孙中山受难

6月18日是纪念已故孙中山博士在1922年因陈炯明将军在广州击败其军队而遭受苦难的周年纪念日，当地党部将于当日上午9时在其总部举行纪念会议。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, TUESDAY, JUNE 11, 1935

Position Of
A.-O. Bank To
Be Disclosed

Balance Sheet Up To
Time Of Closure To
Be Published

AUDITOR WILL THEN
MAKE EXAMINATION

Liquidator Will Make Full
Statement Of Assets At
True Market Value

A balance sheet reflecting the position of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation as of May 24, the date on which the Bank closed its doors preparatory to liquidation, will be released for publication some time this week, Mr. Frank L. Hough, liquidator of the Bank, told press representatives yesterday.

This balance sheet, based on the showings of the Bank's books, has already been prepared and is now being checked personally by Mr. Henry De Vault, a public accountant employed by Mr. Hough. It is expected that similar balance sheets for the other two Raven companies now being liquidated — the American - Oriental Finance Corporation and the Raven Trust Company—will be ready for publication in the near future, Mr. Hough stated.

The liquidator emphasized that the balance sheet to be published this week will show the position of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation according to the Bank's own books. It will then be the task of Mr. De Vault to carry out a thorough audit. In other words, each item in the balance sheet will have to be verified. Particularly, it will be necessary to check the assets disclosed by the books against the assets as actually found.

Actual State Of Affairs

When this job has been completed, a fresh balance sheet disclosing the actual state of affairs found by the liquidator will be prepared and published. This document will show the Bank's assets at their real market worth, including actual cash on hand.

Mr. Harry A. Luker, receiver for Nichols Super Yarn and Carpets, Fed. Inc., a Tientsin firm and one of the largest debtors of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, arrived in Shanghai from the North by train yesterday morning to consult with Judge Milton J. Helmick of the U. S. Court for China. He was accompanied by his attorney, Mr. A. R. Morrison.

The Nichols Company, which was placed in receivership some time ago at the instance of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, is understood to be indebted to the latter in a sum said to be in the neighbourhood of $1,000,-000, most of which is secured by mortgages on raw materials.

Another arrival here yesterday morning by train from the North was Mr. William T. Collins, Clerk of the U. S. Court. Mr. Collins' return indicates that the uncompleted sessions of the Court in North China are likely to remain uncompleted for some little time. It is believed that Judge Helmick will not return to complete them until the liquidation of the Raven interests here is well under way.

Mr. Watson's Denial

Mr. Felthan Watson, U. S. District Attorney, said yesterday that he had not authorized the use of his name in connection with a statement issued by the Rev. C. L. Boynton of the National Christian Council last Saturday. This statement purported to contain "Information for Missionary Investors in the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, American-Oriental Finance Corporation and the Raven Trust Company" compiled after a conference with F. J. Raven, H. Sandor, T. F. McCrea, Felthan Watson and George Sellett.

"The first time I saw the statement," Mr. Watson declared, "was when it appeared in one of the local papers. I was not consulted. To the best of my knowledge I have never met the author, Mr. Boynton."

A similar disavowal of Mr. Boynton's statement was made earlier by Dr. George Sellett, attorney for the Bank liquidator, who said he considered it a mistake for Mr. Boynton to make use of his name in such a way as to make it possible for a reader to infer that the statement had his endorsement.

Mr. Boynton stated to a representative of "The Shanghai Times," yesterday that there had been a misunderstanding regarding the use of the word "conference" in his communication, his use of the word being merely intended to imply that he had spoken with certain officials connected with the bank's liquidation.

《字林西报》，1935年6月11日，星期二

美亚银行
状况将予披露

截至停业时的
资产负债表将予公布

审计员随后
将进行审查

清算人将以真实市场价值
对资产作出完整陈述

该银行清算人弗兰克·L·霍夫（Frank L. Hough）先生昨日告诉媒体代表，反映美亚银行（American-Oriental Banking Corporation）截至5月24日（即该行为准备清算而关门之日）状况的资产负债表，将于本周内某个时间发布以供公布。

这份基于该银行账簿记录的资产负债表已经编制完毕，目前正由霍夫先生聘用的公共会计师亨利·德·沃尔特（Henry De Vault）先生亲自核对。霍夫先生表示，预计另外两家正在清算的雷文（Raven）旗下公司——美亚金融公司（American - Oriental Finance Corporation）和雷文信托公司（Raven Trust Company）——的类似资产负债表也将在不久的将来准备好予以公布。

清算人强调，本周将公布的资产负债表将根据银行自身的账簿显示美亚银行的状况。随后，德·沃尔特先生的任务将是进行彻底审计。换言之，资产负债表中的每一项都必须经过核实。特别是，有必要将账簿所披露的资产与实际发现的资产进行核对。

实际状况

当这项工作完成后，将编制并公布一份新的资产负债表，披露清算人发现的实际状况。该文件将以真实的市场价值显示银行的资产，包括手头实际现金。

哈里·A·卢克（Harry A. Luker）先生是天津一家公司 Nichols Super Yarn and Carpets, Fed. Inc. 的接管人，该公司也是美亚银行最大的债务人之一，他于昨日上午乘火车从北方抵达上海，以便与美国驻华法院的米尔顿·J·赫尔米克（Milton J. Helmick）法官磋商。陪同他前来的是他的律师 A. R. 莫里森（A. R. Morrison）先生。

据悉，尼科尔斯公司（Nichols Company）此前应美亚银行的要求被置于接管之下，欠后者款项据称约为1,000,000美元，其中大部分以原材料抵押作为担保。

另一位于昨日上午乘火车从北方抵达此处的是美国驻华法院书记员威廉·T·柯林斯（William T. Collins）先生。柯林斯先生的返回表明，美国驻华法院在华北未完成的庭审可能会再搁置一小段时间。人们认为，赫尔米克法官在此处的雷文利益相关方清算工作全面展开之前，不会回来完成这些庭审。

沃森先生的否认

美国地区检察官费尔坦·沃森（Felthan Watson）先生昨日表示，他并未授权在上周六全国基督教协进会（National Christian Council）的 C. L. 博因顿（C. L. Boynton）牧师发布的声明中使用他的名字。该声明声称包含“致美亚银行、美亚金融公司和雷文信托公司的传教士投资者的信息”，这些信息是在与 F. J. 雷文（F. J. Raven）、H. 桑多尔（H. Sandor）、T. F. 麦克雷（T. F. McCrea）、费尔坦·沃森和乔治·塞莱特（George Sellett）会晤后编制的。

沃森先生宣称：“我第一次看到这份声明，是它在本地一家报纸上刊登的时候。我并未被征询意见。据我所知，我从未见过作者博因顿先生。”

银行清算人的律师乔治·塞莱特博士早些时候也对博因顿先生的声明作出了类似的否认，他表示，他认为博因顿先生以这种方式使用他的名字是一个错误，因为这可能使读者推断该声明得到了他的背书。

博因顿先生昨日向《字林西报》的一位代表表示，关于在他通讯中使用“conference”（会晤/会议）一词存在误解，他使用该词 merely intended to imply（仅旨在暗示）他曾与某些负责银行清算工作的官员交谈过。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, MONDAY, JUNE 10, 1935

Dr. Sellett Disapproves Of
Mr. Boynton's Statement

Circular To Missionary Investors In American-Oriental Bank Should Not Have Borne Name
Of Liquidator's Counsel; No Conference

The Rev. C. I. Boynton, of the National Christian Council, on Saturday circulated a statement containing "Information for Missionary Investors in the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, American-Oriental Finance Corporation, Asia Realty Company and the Raven Trust Company." The statement purported to have been "prepared by C. L. Boynton of the National Christian Council, after conference with F. J. Raven, H. Sandor, T. F. McCrea, Felthan Watson and George Sellett."

When interviewed yesterday regarding this statement, Dr. Sellett, counsel for the Liquidator, said: "I am not sufficiently informed at this early date to agree or disagree with Mr. Boynton's statement in its entirety. I did not participate in any conference which Mr. Boynton may have held with the other persons mentioned in the circular. On the morning of June 8, Mr. Boynton saw me in the lobby of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation's premises and handed me a typewritten statement of three or four pages and asked me to read it. The statement was substantially in the form of a mimeographed statement, which, I am told, Mr. Boynton circulated that afternoon. After Mr. Boynton and I exchanged a few comments upon it, the statement was handed back to Mr. Boynton and our short conversation ended.

"I consider it was a mistake for Mr. Boynton later to make use of my name in the circular in such way as to make it possible for a reader to infer that the alleged facts and the views and opinions expressed therein had my indorsement. Mr. Hough, the liquidator of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, American-Oriental Finance Corporation, and the Raven Trust Company and trustee of the Asia Realty Company and his assistants are proceeding with their work as expeditiously as possible and I am quite sure that as soon as Mr. Hough is in possession of facts, the disclosure of which will be of interest and helpful to the depositors, investors, shareholders and other parties concerned, he will choose an appropriate means to disseminate this information."

Mr. Boynton's Statement

The statement circulated by Mr. Boynton read, in part, as follows:—

"The Asia Realty Company made sacrificial efforts to assist in salvaging the bank and forestalling liquidation, but the money market was so tight that the efforts were unavailing. It is hoped that the trusteeship under the provisions of the recent recovery legislation may relieve the pressure upon the company. In the present state of the investor's mind, there is a tendency to cash all loan certificates upon maturity, whereas normally over three-fourths would be renewed. If this tendency continues, the company would be forced into liquidation to the detriment of the stockholders, whereas under a trustee some type of 'moratorium' is possible which might enable the company to carry on successfully and salvage all assets."

Continuing further, the statement advises missionary investors or depositors in the three institutions now in liquidation to refrain from seeking legal assistance, since such action would involve said investors in superfluous legal expense. In this connection, the statement adds:

"It may be well, however, to send securities and powers-of-attorney to local missionary representatives to act for out-of-town creditors in order to expedite settlement. Detailed advice will be sent on this point later. The liquidator has full power and his course is rather minutely prescribed by law and he will protect the interests of creditors and debtors alike.

"No funds will be paid out till the accountants make their report on the affairs of the three institutions involved, and they will be paid thereafter as rapidly as funds become available in the order of their legal priority."

Handbook Referred To

At this point, the statement quotes from the Accountants' Handbook where reference is made to bankruptcy cases. The handbook states:

"The security held by those having secured claims is converted into money. Any excess received over the amount of a secured claim goes into the fund available to general creditors. The secured creditor becomes a general creditor for the amount of any deficiency.

"Unsecured claims are paid in the following order:

1.—Taxes due.
2.—Costs of preserving the property after the petition is filed.
3.—Filing fees paid by creditors and costs of reclaiming fraudulently transferred and concealed property.
4.—Costs of bankruptcy proceedings.
5.—Wages due workmen, clerks, salesmen and servants, which have been earned during the three months prior to filing the petition up to $300 to each claimant.
6.—Debts having priority by laws of the state.
7.—Other general claims are paid dividends as the estate is liquidated."

Raven Trust Parent Firm

Concerning the relations of the three institutions in liquidation and the Asia Realty Company, the statement points out that the Raven Trust Company is the parent company and that its common or voting shares are held largely by Mr. Raven and his relatives. Says the statement:

"The principal investments of the Raven Trust Company were in the shares of the American Oriental Finance Corporation. It owned the majority of the shares of the AOFC, which in turn owned the majority of the common shares of the American Oriental Banking Corporation and of the Asia Realty Company. It is apparent thus that in case any of these three is unable to make any returns on common stock, the prospect of the creditors of the Raven Trust Company receiving anything is correspondingly reduced.

"The solvency of RTC is thus dependent on the solvency of AOFC, which in turn is dependent on the solvency of AOBC and ARCO, but the solvency of AOBC was not dependent upon that of ARCO, nor was ARCO dependent upon AOBC."

"The Raven Trust Company held various 'living' trusts which are not affected by recent events, as in every case specific securities are lodged against each trust, and these securities are not the property of the Trust Company and cannot be dealt with by the liquidator except as he may determine that a new trustee must be found for them."

In conclusion the statement lists the four class of creditors in the order of priority of payment. They follow:

1.—Secured creditors (debenture holders, living trusts, etc.).
2.—Depositors — current, savings and term (fixed).
3.—Preferred shareholders.
4. — Common shareholders, whether voting or non-voting.

《字林西报》，1935年6月10日，星期一

塞莱特博士不赞成
博因顿先生的声明

致美亚银行传教士投资者的通告不应署上清算人法律顾问之名；并未举行会议

全国基督教协进会的 C. I. 博因顿牧师于周六散发了一份声明，其中包含“致美亚银行公司、美亚金融公司、亚洲地产公司及雷文信托公司传教士投资者的信息”。该声明声称由全国基督教协进会的 C. L. 博因顿在与 F. J. 雷文、H. 桑多尔、T. F. 麦克雷、费尔瑟姆·沃森（Felthan Watson）(音译) 和乔治·塞莱特协商后拟定。

昨日就此事接受采访时，清算人的法律顾问塞莱特博士表示：“在此早期阶段，我掌握的信息尚不足以对博因顿先生的声明全文表示赞同或反对。我并未参与博因顿先生可能与通告中提及的其他人士举行的任何会议。6月8日上午，博因顿先生在美亚银行公司办公场所的大厅里见到我，递给我一份三四页的打字稿，请我阅读。该声明实质上是一份油印声明的形式，据我所知，博因顿先生于当天下午散发了这份声明。在博因顿先生和我就此交换了几句意见后，声明被交还给他，我们简短的谈话也随之结束。

“我认为博因顿先生后来在通告中以这种方式使用我的名字是一个错误，这使得读者可能推断出其中所述的事实以及表达的观点和意见得到了我的背书。美亚银行公司、美亚金融公司和雷文信托公司的清算人兼亚洲地产公司受托人霍夫先生及其助手们正在尽可能迅速地开展工作，我确信，一旦霍夫先生掌握了那些披露出来将对存款人、投资者、股东及其他相关方具有利益和帮助的事实，他将选择适当的方式传播这些信息。”

博因顿先生的声明

博因顿先生散发的声明部分内容如下：—

“亚洲地产公司为协助挽救银行并阻止清算做出了牺牲性的努力，但资金市场如此紧张，致使这些努力徒劳无功。希望根据最近的复苏立法规定设立的受托管理能够缓解该公司面临的压力。在目前投资者的心态下，存在一种在贷款凭证到期时全部兑现的倾向，而通常情况下超过四分之三的凭证会被续期。如果这种趋势持续下去，公司将被迫进行清算，从而损害股东的利益；而在受托管理下，某种形式的‘延期偿付’是可能的，这或许能使公司成功维持运营并保全所有资产。”

声明进一步建议，目前正处于清算过程中的三家机构的传教士投资者或存款人应避免寻求法律援助，因为此类行动将使上述投资者卷入不必要的法律费用。对此，声明补充道：

“不过，将证券和授权委托书发送给当地的传教士代表，由其代理外地债权人，以加快结算进程，或许是明智之举。关于这一点的详细建议将在稍后发出。清算人拥有充分的权力，其行事方针由法律作了相当细致的规定，他将保护债权人和债务人的双方利益。

“在会计师对涉及的三家机构的事务作出报告之前，不会支付任何款项，此后将根据资金的到位情况，按照法律规定的优先顺序尽快支付。”

提及手册

此时，声明引用了《会计师手册》中涉及破产案件的内容。该手册指出：

“持有担保债权的人所持有的担保品将被变现。超过担保债权金额的任何超额部分将归入可供普通债权人分配的基金。担保债权人就任何不足额部分成为普通债权人。

无担保债权按以下顺序支付：

1.—欠缴税款。
2.—提交申请后为保全财产所产生的费用。
3.—债权人支付的立案费以及追回被欺诈转移和隐匿财产的费用。
4.—破产程序的费用。
5.—欠付工人、职员、推销员和仆役的工资，即在提交申请前三个月内赚取的工资，每位索赔人最高300美元。
6.—根据州法律享有优先权的债务。
7.—其他普通债权在 estate（遗产/资产）清算过程中支付股息。”

雷文信托为母公司

关于处于清算中的三家机构与亚洲地产公司之间的关系，声明指出雷文信托公司是母公司，其普通股或投票权股份主要由雷文先生及其亲属持有。声明称：

“雷文信托公司的主要投资在于美亚金融公司的股份。它拥有美亚金融公司的大部分股份，而美亚金融公司又拥有美亚银行公司和亚洲地产公司的大部分普通股。因此显而易见，如果这三家公司中任何一家无法就普通股产生任何回报，雷文信托公司的债权人获得任何偿付的可能性也会相应降低。

“因此，雷文信托公司的偿债能力取决于美亚金融公司的偿债能力，而后者又取决于美亚银行公司和亚洲地产公司的偿债能力；但美亚银行公司的偿债能力并不依赖于亚洲地产公司，亚洲地产公司也不依赖于美亚银行公司。”

“雷文信托公司持有一些‘生前’信托，这些信托不受近期事件的影响，因为在每种情况下，都有特定的证券作为每项信托的担保，而这些证券并非信托公司的财产，除非清算人确定必须为其寻找新的受托人，否则他不得处置这些证券。”

最后，声明按支付优先顺序列出了四类债权人。具体如下：

1.—有担保债权人（债券持有人、生前信托等）。
2.—存款人 — 活期、储蓄和定期（固定）。
3.—优先股股东。
4. — 普通股股东，无论是否有投票权。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, SATURDAY, JUNE 8, 1935

A-O BANK AFFAIRS
INVESTIGATED

Skeleton Staff Working on
Liquidation

DOORS CLOSED AGAINST
THE CURIOUS

Within the bare and deserted pre-
mises of the American-Oriental Bank-
ing Corporation, 29 Nanking Road,
which closed its doors just two weeks
ago to-day, there exists a semblance
of activity.
A skeleton staff is at work with the
auditor in preparing a balance sheet
and intermittently there is heard the
metallic click of automatic adding
machines, vibrating throughout the
building.
An office once occupied by one of
the bank managers has been trans-
formed into headquarters for Mr.
Frank L. Hough, the liquidator ap-
pointed by Judge Milton J. Helmick
of the United States Court. Here he
is busy from early morning until late
night, holding conferences with his
legal adviser, Mr. George Sellett,
former U.S. District Attorney, Mr.
Henry De Vault, auditor, and others
with whom it is important to confer
in the interests of liquidation.
On the opposite side of the lobby
in the office formerly occupied by Mr.
J. Warner Brown, Mr. De Vault has
his headquarters. His staff are scat-
tered throughout the various depart-
ments.
Several Chinese are stationed in the
lobby just to watch things and a guard
is stationed at the door to prevent
the curious from entering the build-
ing.

Visitors Barred

In talking with a representative of
the "North-China Daily News" who
visited him in his office yesterday,
Mr. Hough explained that this step
was taken because so many persons
had called upon him that he found it
necessary to bar all visitors in order
to get on with the business of liquida-
tion.
In the course of conversation Mr.
Hough also pointed out that he will
not make any official statement until
he, himself, knows something more of
conditions. He said:—
"We are moving slowly and care-
fully because this must be an order-
ly liquidation rather than a wreck-
ing."
Just now Mr. Hough is giving the
greater portion of his attention to
cutting down expenses. He already
has cancelled all non-essential
services and has removed all rented
apparatus not needed. He explained
that this was being done "to turn as
much into money as we possibly can".
Mr. Hough also revealed the rather
surprising fact that it was not until
he read it in the newspaper that he
knew of his appointment as trustee of
the Asia Realty Company. For the
present he is centring all his time and
attention on bank matters.

《字林西报》，1935年6月8日，星期六

调查美亚银行事务

精简班子开展清算工作

大门对好奇者关闭

在南京路29号的美亚银行公司空旷且荒废的办公场所内——该行恰好在两周前的今天关门停业——存在着一种活动的表象。
一个精简的班子正与审计师一起编制资产负债表，自动加法机发出的金属咔哒声不时响起，回荡在整个大楼中。
一间曾由一位银行经理使用的办公室已被改造为弗兰克·L. 霍夫先生的总部，他是美国法院米尔顿·J. 赫尔米克法官任命的清算人。在这里，他从清晨忙碌到深夜，与其法律顾问、前美国地区检察官乔治·塞莱特先生、审计师亨利·德·沃尔特先生以及其他对于清算利益而言有必要进行磋商的人士举行会议。
在大厅的另一侧，在曾由 J. 华纳·布朗先生使用的办公室里，德·沃尔特先生设有他的总部。他的工作人员分散在各个部门。
几名华人驻守在大厅，仅负责监视情况，门口还有一名警卫，以防止好奇者进入大楼。

禁止访客

霍夫先生昨日在其办公室接受《字林西报》代表采访时解释说，采取这一步骤是因为来访者众多，他发现有必要禁止所有访客，以便推进清算业务。
在谈话过程中，霍夫先生还指出，在他本人更多地了解情况之前，他不会发表任何官方声明。他说：—
“我们行动缓慢而谨慎，因为这必须是一次有序的清算，而不是一场破坏。”
目前，霍夫先生将大部分注意力集中在削减开支上。他已经取消了所有非必要的服务，并移除了所有不需要的租赁设备。他解释说，这样做是为了“尽可能多地变现”。
霍夫先生还透露了一个相当令人惊讶的事实，即直到他在报纸上看到报道，他才知道自己被任命为亚洲地产公司的受托人。目前，他将所有的时间和精力都集中在银行事务上。

THE CHINA PRESS, SUNDAY, JUNE 9, 1935

Creditors Of
Raven Group
Given Advice

Long Statement Tells
Missionaries What To
Do; Workings Of Three
Closed Firms Explained

First Payments To Be
Made When Accountants
Have Completed Check

Under the heading "Information for Missionary Investors in the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, American-Oriental Finance Corporation, Asia Realty Company, and the Raven Trust Company," a long statement prepared by Mr. C. L. Boynton of the National Christian Council, after conference with Mr. F. J. Raven, organizer of the Raven interests, Mr. Hugo Sandor, manager of the Asia Realty Company, Mr. T. F. McCrea, official of the Asia Realty Company, Mr. Felthan Watson, U.S. District Attorney, and Dr. George Sellett, former U.S. District Attorney and appointed legal adviser to Mr. Frank L. Hough, liquidator of the three defunct Raven institutions, was issued yesterday to a number of missionaries in the city.

Missionary funds in the organizations THE CHINA PRESS was informed yesterday, total approximately $3,500,000 exclusive of personal deposits.

Raven Comments

In yesterday's statement, Mr. Raven declares that he has no financial interests outside his own companies, that he withdrew no money whatever from the bank in anticipation of its closing, and has set aside no funds in the name of his wife or children to secure their financial independence, and all he has is at stake in the liquidation of these interests.

With reference to the Asia Realty Company, the statement continues: "The Asia Realty Company made sacrificial efforts to assist in salvaging the bank and forestalling liquidation, but the money market was so tight that the efforts were unavailing. It is hoped that the trusteeship under the provisions of the recent recovery legislation may relieve the pressure upon the company. In the present state of the investor's mind, there is a tendency to cash all loan certificates upon maturity, whereas normally over three-fourths would be renewed. If this tendency continues, the company would be forced into liquidation to the detriment of the stockholders, whereas under a trustee some type of 'moratorium' is possible which might enable the company to carry on successfully and salvage all assets."

Continuing further, the statement advises missionary investors or depositors in the three institutions now in liquidation to refrain from seeking legal assistance, since such action would involve said investors in superfluous legal expense. In this connection, the statement adds:

"It may be well, however, to send securities and powers-of-attorney to local missionary representatives to act for out-of-town creditors in order to expedite settlement. Detailed advice will be sent on this point later. The liquidator has full power and his course is rather minutely prescribed by law and he will protect the interests of creditors and debtors alike."

"No funds will be paid out till the accountants make their report on the affairs of the three institutions involved, and they will be paid thereafter as rapidly as funds

雷文集团债权人
获予建议

长篇声明告知传教士
该如何行事；解释三家
停业公司的运作情况

待会计师完成核查后
将进行首次支付

昨日，向本市多名传教士发布了一份长篇声明，标题为“致美亚银行公司、美亚金融公司、亚洲地产公司及雷文信托公司的传教士投资者之信息”。该声明由全国基督教协进会的 C. L. Boynton 先生在与雷文利益集团组织者 F. J. Raven 先生、亚洲地产公司经理 Hugo Sandor 先生、亚洲地产公司官员 T. F. McCrea 先生、美国地区检察官 Felthan Watson 先生，以及前美国地区检察官、现被任命为三家已停业雷文机构清算人 Frank L. Hough 先生的法律顾问的 George Sellett 博士会晤后拟定。

据《字林西报》昨日获悉，各传教士在这些组织中的资金总额约为350万美元，不包括个人存款。

雷文的评论

在昨日的声明中，雷文先生宣称，除其自有公司外，他没有任何财务利益；他在银行关闭前并未从中提取任何资金，也未以其妻子或子女的名义预留任何资金以确保他们的经济独立；他所有的一切均牵涉于这些利益的清算之中。

关于亚洲地产公司，声明继续写道：“亚洲地产公司为协助挽救银行并避免清算做出了牺牲性的努力，但货币市场如此紧缩，致使努力徒劳无功。希望根据近期复苏立法的规定设立的托管安排能够缓解该公司面临的压力。在目前投资者的心态下，存在一种倾向，即在贷款凭证到期时全部兑现，而正常情况下超过四分之三 would be renewed（应予续期）。如果这种趋势持续下去，公司将被迫进入清算程序，从而损害股东利益；而在托管人管理下，某种形式的‘延期偿付’是可能的，这或许能使公司成功维持运营并保全所有资产。”

声明进一步建议，目前正处于清算过程中的三家机构的传教士投资者或储户不要寻求法律援助，因为此类行动将使上述投资者卷入不必要的法律费用。对此，声明补充道：

“不过，将证券和授权委托书发送给当地的传教士代表，由其代理外地债权人行事，以加快结算进程，或许是明智之举。关于这一点的详细建议稍后将发出。清算人拥有充分的权力，其行动路线由法律作了相当细致的规定，他将保护债权人和债务人的利益。”

AUDITOR APPOINTED
FOR A.-O. BANK

任命审计员

THE CHINA PRESS. THURSDAY, JUNE 6, 1935
Hough Swings Into Action
To Liquidate Raven Interests

Sellett Is Named
As Legal Adviser;
DeVault To Start
Audit This Morning

Drop In Real Estate
Values Is Feared

Swinging into action immediately to speed up the liquidation of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation, the American-Oriental Finance Corporation, and the Raven Trust Company, Mr. Frank L. Hough, general manager of the RCA Victor Company of China appointed liquidator of the three companies by Judge Milton J. Helmick on Monday, has named Dr. George Sellett, former U.S. District Attorney and now conducting a private law practice, legal adviser to the liquidator.

In addition, Mr. Hough has employed Mr. Henry S. DeVault to conduct an independent audit of the books on the three companies. Mr. DeVault, assisted by his staff of auditors, will start work this morning on a comprehensive checkup of the books of the three companies. As soon as the audit is completed, it will be submitted to Judge Helmick.

The three bonds required by the liquidator, which total U.S. $55,000, have been prepared by Mr. Hough through insurance companies and will be filed with the U. S. Court this morning, Mr. Hough stated yesterday.

Trustee To Be Named
Judge Helmick, who has received a petition from the Asia Realty Company for the appointment of a special trustee, under Section 77-B of the "New Deal" legislation, has not yet made the appointment. According to a official of the court, he is expected to name the trustee either today or tomorrow following further study of the law and its application here and in the case of the Asia Realty Company, another Raven interest.

Yesterday afternoon a CHINA PRESS reporter found Mr. Hough busy in the former office of Mr. F. J. Kleffel, former vice-president and manager of the American-Oriental Banking Corporation. Mr. Hough yesterday conferred with Mr. DeVault and Mr. N. F. Allman, lawyer representing several American creditors and depositors of the three organizations.

Mr. Hough said yesterday that it would be impossible at this time to state when actual payments to depositors would be made but that such action would be announced as soon as practicable. Payment of depositors will be made on a percentage basis to all depositors regardless of the amount of their deposits.

Fears that the possible action of the liquidator in immediately converting into cash local real estate properties owned by the three defunct Raven interests continue to be held throughout the town. Nevertheless, the liquidator at his discretion may sell such assets as he sees fit. Many of the assets of the three Raven organizations, it is stated, consist of real estate properties whose selling price now has been reduced as much as 50 per cent from its former value. If these properties are placed on the local market and sold for cash, they are most likely to seriously depress all real estate values in the city.

"Grotesque Values"
"If the liquidator decides to convert real estate assets of the Raven Company into cash," an American official told a CHINA PRESS reporter, "I cannot see that such a step will have a far-reaching effect. Real estate values here have soared sky-high, entirely and grotesquely out of proportion to their actual worth. If these values are depressed, it may eventually put the market on a more stable basis than on the abnormal inflated basis that it has been in the past five or six years."

The American-Oriental Banking Corporation, the American-Oriental Finance Corporation, and the Raven Trust Company failed on May 23. Mr. Frank J. Raven, organizer of the three companies, blamed the American silver purchasing policy as the sole reason behind the failure of the three organizations.

Bank Door Still Barred
Yesterday the American-Oriental Bank on Nanking Road continued to be locked and guarded by the S.M.P. Newspapers, letters, and magazines addressed to Mr. F. J. Raven and other former bank officials lay scattered in the barred bank entrance. On the second floor, the seals placed by the U. S. marshal were broken and except for a single stenographer assisting Mr. Hough, all offices were deserted. Ironically enough, the sign on Mr. Raven's office read "out."

The American-Oriental Banking-Corporation has about 8,000 depositors of some 40 nationalities whose deposits total slightly over $8,000,000. It claims a capital of U. S. $550,000 and $1,250,000. Last year it reported a profit slightly less than $600,000. The claimed assets of the AOBC, the AOFC, the Raven Trust Company, and the Asia Realty Company are between $80,000,000 and $70,000,000.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》，1935年6月6日，星期四
霍夫迅速行动
清算雷文利益集团

塞莱特被任命
为法律顾问；
德沃尔特今晨
开始审计

担心房地产
价值下跌

为加速美亚银行公司、美亚金融公司和雷文信托公司的清算工作，中国 RCA 维克多公司（RCA Victor Company of China）总经理 Frank L. Hough 先生立即采取行动。Hough 先生于周一由 Milton J. Helmick 法官任命为这三家公司的清算人，并已任命前美国地区检察官、现从事私人法律执业的 George Sellett 博士担任清算人的法律顾问。

此外，Hough 先生还聘请了 Henry S. DeVault 先生对这三家公司的账簿进行独立审计。DeVault 先生在其审计员团队的协助下，将于今晨开始对这三家公司的账簿进行全面核查。审计一经完成，将提交给 Helmick 法官。

Hough 先生昨日表示，清算人所需的三份保证金总计55,000美元，已通过保险公司办理完毕，将于今晨递交至美国法院。

将任命托管人
Helmick 法官已收到亚洲地产公司根据“新政”立法第77-B条提出的任命特别托管人的请愿书，但尚未作出任命。据一位法院官员称，预计他将在进一步研究该法律及其在此地以及亚洲地产公司（另一雷文利益集团）案件中的适用情况后，于今日或明日任命托管人。

昨日下午，《字林西报》记者发现 Hough 先生正忙于前美亚银行公司副行长兼经理 F. J. Kleffel 先生的原办公室内。Hough 先生昨日与 DeVault 先生以及代表三家机构多名美国债权人和储户的律师 N. F. Allman 先生进行了会谈。

Hough 先生昨日表示，目前无法说明何时能向储户进行实际支付，但一旦可行将立即宣布。无论存款金额多少，都将按比例向所有储户支付款项。

全市范围内仍持续存在一种担忧，即清算人可能立即将三家已停业雷文利益集团拥有的本地房地产变现。尽管如此，清算人可自行决定出售其认为合适的资产。据悉，三家雷文机构的许多资产由房地产组成，其售价较以往价值已大幅降低多达50%。如果这些房产投放本地市场并现金出售，极有可能严重压低本市所有的房地产价值。

“荒谬的价值”
一位美国官员告诉《字林西报》记者：“如果清算人决定将雷文公司的房地产资产变现，我看不出此举会产生深远影响。此地的房地产价值已飙升至天际，完全且荒谬地与其实际价值不成比例。如果这些价值回落，最终可能会使市场建立在比过去五六年那种异常膨胀的基础更为稳定的基础之上。”

美亚银行公司、美亚金融公司和雷文信托公司于5月23日倒闭。这三家公司的组织者 Frank J. Raven 先生指责美国的白银收购政策是导致这三家机构失败的唯一原因。

银行大门依然紧闭
昨日，位于南京路的美亚银行继续处于锁闭状态，并由上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）警卫看守。寄给 F. J. Raven 先生及其他前银行官员的报纸、信件和杂志散落在被封锁的银行入口处。在二楼，美国法警张贴的封条已被撕毁，除了一名协助 Hough 先生的速记员外，所有办公室均空无一人。具有讽刺意味的是，雷文先生办公室门上的标牌写着“外出”。

美亚银行公司拥有来自约40个国籍的大约8,000名储户，存款总额略超过800万美元。该行声称资本为550,000美元和1,250,000美元（原文如此，可能指不同类别的资本或存在笔误）。去年该行报告的利润略低于600,000美元。据称，美亚银行公司（AOBC）、美亚金融公司（AOFC）、雷文信托公司和亚洲地产公司的资产总额在7,000万至8,000万美元之间。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, JUNE 6, 1935

THE LIQUIDATOR
Judge Milton J. Helmick has been
as good as his word. He has given
prompt and exhaustive consideration
to the selection of a liquidator for
the American-Oriental Banking Cor-
poration and associated concerns. Mr.
F. L. Hough is a comparative new-
comer to Shanghai, but he is well-
esteemed as a practical man of affairs
and independent judgment, besides
being an approved business man of
good standing. The public will rec-
ognize, therefore, that Judge
Helmick has made a sound choice.
The task which confronts Mr. Hough
is exceedingly difficult and delicate.
It is essential that he should have
every support which can be given
to him, apart from that derived from
the judicial authorities under whose
instructions he acts. This support
can be most suitably shown by leav-
ing him a clear field with the know-
ledge that he commands general
confidence. His acceptance of an
onerous task indicates his possession
of proper public spirit and that can
be best acclaimed by a sympathetic
understanding of his difficulties,
allied to a trust in his intention to
operate the liquidation to the best
interests of all legitimately concerned
therein.

《上海泰晤士报》，1935年6月6日，星期四

清算人
Milton J. Helmick 法官信守诺言。他对美亚银行公司及相关企业的清算人选任给予了及时且详尽的考量。F. L. Hough 先生虽是上海的相对新来者，但他作为一名务实的商业人士和具有独立判断力的人备受推崇，此外也是一位公认的良好信誉商人。因此，公众会认识到，Helmick 法官做出了明智的选择。

Hough 先生面临的任务极其困难且微妙。除了来自他依其指示行事的司法当局的支持外，他必须获得所能给予的一切支持。这种支持最适宜的表现方式是让他拥有广阔的施展空间，并让他知道自己享有普遍的信任。他接受这项繁重的任务，表明他具备适当的公共精神，而对他的困难表示同情理解，并信任他旨在为所有合法相关方的最大利益进行清算的意图，便是对他最好的赞誉。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Wednesday, June 5, 1935

THE AMERICAN ORIENTAL GROUP.
LIQUIDATOR APPOINTED
By H. G. W. WOODHEAD, C. B. E
(Editor, Oriental Affairs)

JUDGE Helmick, of the U.S. Court for China, who was holding a session of that tribunal in Peiping when the suspension of business by the American Oriental Group was announced, very wisely refused to be stampeded into the appointment of a Liquidator until he had been able to make investigations on the spot. He flew down to Shanghai on Sunday and after a day spent in conferences with leading American executives and attorneys named Mr. Frank L. Hough, Managing Director of the R.C.A. Victor Co., of China, as Liquidator. Rumour had been busy with several other names, since it became known that the Judge did not consider technical banking experience an essential qualification, but was in search of a man "of practical business ability, impartiality and courage of the sternest sort" to do "a hard boiled job." It was reported that several potential candidates—including Mr. Carl Seitz, and Major Arthur Bassett—had been approached, but that the concerns with which they are associated could not see their way to release them for what for some months to come must be practically a whole-time job. Mr. Hough has had considerable experience in business in China and other foreign countries, having first come out to the Far East in 1918. He has had previous experience as a Liquidator in America. And he approaches his new task from an entirely detached viewpoint, as he is not personally acquainted either with Mr. F. J. Raven, the President, or Mr. J. Kieffel the Vice-President, of the American-Oriental Bank. He has stated that Judge Helmick and he are in agreement that the interests of the depositors in the Bank must come before any other consideration.

Mr. Hough's Task
THE Liquidator of the three associated Raven enterprises, the Bank, the Finance Corporation, and the Trust, is required to enter into bonds aggregating U.S.$55,000 before taking up his duties, and will be empowered "to employ counsel and auditors, discharge present employees, take such action as may be necessary to collect the assets of the Company and reduce such assets to cash, give receipts, grant acquittances, effect compromises, institute and defend legal proceedings, and exercise the authority usually granted to liquidators." The Bank will presumably exercise most of his attention at the outset, as the most urgent problem is that of affording relief to the depositors—many of them with small accounts—who are suffering real hardship from their inability to draw upon them. But the Raven interests are so extensive and interwoven that much must obviously depend upon the concurrent reorganization of the Asia Realty Company.
The Bank, according to the latest Balance Sheet (for the year ending December 31, 1934) included among its resources Loans and Discounts amounting to $8,966,430, and stocks and bonds valued at $37,767. The nature of the security for the loans is not revealed but it may be assumed that they include mortgages, stocks and shares, and liens upon cargo, etc. None of these will be easily realizable, under existing conditions, at anything like their normal value. And if, as is believed, mortgages figure prominently among the loans, wholesale foreclosures would not only dissipate a large percentage of the assets, but adversely affect any project for the reorganization of the Asia Realty Company, and incidentally inflict serious injury upon other local Land Companies. The more valuable sites in Shanghai, at the moment, would not realize more than a fraction of their normal value by a forced sale. And such procedure would inevitably depreciate the value of adjacent properties, regardless of their revenue-earning capacity. Indeed, if there were any risk of the combined American-Oriental and Asia Realty property-holdings being put upon the market it would become imperative for the other large land interests to consider the possibility of a combine to buttress up the property market. For there is no reason to suppose that the present depreciated property values are permanent. The land is located in a city that is constantly growing in spite of the depression, and will expand with accelerated speed when that depression is over.

The Asia Realty Co.
THE Asia Realty Company at the end of 1934 had debenture issues totalling $6,098,181, to the service of which certain properties were specifically pledged, under a Trust Deed in favour of the Yangtze Insurance Co. The revenues derived from these properties are believed to be considerably in excess of interest requirements, and debenture-holders, therefore, would appear to be amply secured. But the Arco Loan Certificates issued up to the end of 1934, and tantamount to Promissory Notes aggregated $2,355,540, and some form of moratorium in regard to them may be imperative if the holders are ever to get their money back. They would certainly suffer heavy loss if the Company's available assets had to be realized for cash, without delay.
It will be appreciated therefore that though the Liquidator of the American Oriental Companies is not actually concerned with the Asia Realty Company's difficulties, the reciprocal effect of the realization of property assets on both groups cannot be ignored. Mr. Hough will at best find it no easy task to steer between the Scylla of clamorous depositors, and the Charybdis of the conservation of their—and the shareholders'—real interests. His task might be easier to handle if it were possible to constitute depositors' and shareholders' Committees with whom he could hold frank discussions, and who, it might be hoped, would endorse a policy of conservation of assets, rather than their immediate realization. And were this done, it does not seem to be beyond the bounds of possibility that co-operation—and possibly even some financial assistance—might be secured from other land interests and Banks.

Shareholders' And Depositors
DEPOSITORS and shareholders are entitled to be kept informed of the progress of liquidation and the details of reorganization, but it would simplify matters considerably if day to day contact with the Liquidator and the Trustee could be maintained by Committees empowered, respectively, to represent these two groups of interested parties. The smaller depositors, in many instances, obviously cannot afford to await the proceeds of an orderly liquidation. The larger depositors, if their voice could be heard would almost certainly prefer that the smaller clients, should receive preferential treatment if their own interests would be conserved by a policy of holding on to assets, to avert the depreciation that would be the inevitable result of immediate realization. The Liquidator is to file a report on the financial position of the American Oriental Group with the Court, within sixty days from his appointment. It would be well if, in the interval, depositors and shareholders, both of that Group and the Realty Company organised and elected Committees to represent them, and to maintain close contact with the Liquidator, and the Trustee.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1935年6月5日，星期三

美亚集团。
任命清算人
作者：H. G. W. 伍德黑德（H. G. W. Woodhead），C.B.E.
（《东方事务》编辑）

当美亚集团（American Oriental Group）宣布停业时，美国驻华法院的赫尔米克（Helmick）法官正在北平主持该法庭的庭审，他非常明智地拒绝在未能进行实地调查之前仓促任命清算人。他于周日飞抵上海，在与主要的美方高管和律师进行了一天的磋商后，任命 RCA 胜利唱机公司（R.C.A. Victor Co.）中国分公司总经理弗兰克·L·霍夫（Frank L. Hough）先生为清算人。自从得知法官并不认为专业的银行经验是必要资格，而是在寻找一位具备“实际业务能力、公正无私以及最坚定勇气”的人士来执行这项“棘手任务”以来，坊间对其他几个人选的传闻甚嚣尘上。据报道，包括卡尔·塞茨（Carl Seitz）先生和阿瑟·巴塞特（Arthur Bassett）少校在内的几位潜在候选人曾受到接洽，但他们所任职的公司无法同意让他们离职，因为这在未来的几个月里实际上必须是一份全职工作。霍夫先生在中国及其他国家拥有丰富的商业经验，他于1918年首次来到远东。他在美国曾有担任清算人的既往经验。而且他是以完全超然的视角来对待这一新任务的，因为他与美亚银行（American-Oriental Bank）的总裁 F. J. 雷文（F. J. Raven）先生或副总裁 J. 基费尔（J. Kieffel）先生均无私人交情。他表示，他与赫尔米克法官一致认为，银行存款人的利益必须高于任何其他考量。

霍夫先生的任务
作为雷文旗下三家关联企业——银行、金融公司和信托公司——的清算人，霍夫先生在就职前需缴纳总额达55,000美元的保证金，并将被授权“聘请法律顾问和审计师，解雇现有员工，采取必要行动收回公司资产并将其变现，出具收据，给予免责证明，达成和解，提起及应诉法律程序，并行使通常授予清算人的权力。”起初，银行可能会占据他大部分的精力，因为最紧迫的问题是为存款人提供救济——其中许多人账户金额不大——他们因无法取款而遭受真正的困境。但雷文的利益范围广泛且相互交织，因此显然很大程度上取决于亚洲地产公司（Asia Realty Company）的同步重组。
根据最新的资产负债表（截至1934年12月31日年度），银行的资源中包括贷款和贴现共计8,966,430美元，以及价值37,767美元的股票和债券。贷款担保的性质并未披露，但可以推测其中包括抵押贷款、股票和股份，以及对货物等的留置权等。在现有条件下，这些资产都难以按接近其正常价值的价格轻易变现。而且，如果如人们所信，抵押贷款在贷款中占很大比重，那么大规模取消赎回权不仅会损耗大量资产，还会对亚洲地产公司的任何重组计划产生不利影响，并连带严重损害其他本地土地公司。目前，上海较为值钱的地皮若通过强制出售，其变现价值不会超过其正常价值的一小部分。而且，无论其创收能力如何，这种程序不可避免地会使相邻物业贬值。事实上，如果美亚集团和亚洲地产公司的联合地产 holdings 有投放市场的风险，其他大型土地利益方就必须考虑联合起来支撑房地产市场的可能性。因为没有理由认为目前的房地产贬值是永久性的。这片土地位于一座尽管处于萧条期仍在不断发展的城市，一旦萧条结束，它将加速扩张。

亚洲地产公司
截至1934年底，亚洲地产公司发行的债券总额达6,098,181美元，根据一份以扬子保险公司（Yangtze Insurance Co.）为受益人的信托契约，特定物业已被专门抵押用于偿付这些债券。据信，这些物业产生的收入远远超过利息需求，因此债券持有人似乎得到了充分的保障。但是，截至1934年底发行的相当于本票的 Arco 贷款凭证（Arco Loan Certificates）总额达2,355,540美元，如果持有人想要收回资金，针对这些凭证实施某种形式的延期偿付可能是势在必行的。如果公司的可用资产不得不立即变现，持有人肯定会遭受重大损失。
因此可以理解，虽然美亚各公司的清算人并不直接涉及亚洲地产公司的困难，但两组公司资产变现的相互影响不容忽视。霍夫先生最多只能发现，要在喧嚣的存款人这一斯库拉（Scylla，意为险滩）与保护他们及股东的真正利益这一卡律布狄斯（Charybdis，意为漩涡）之间 navigating 绝非易事。如果能够成立存款人和股东委员会，让他与之进行坦率的讨论，并且希望这些委员会能支持保护资产而非立即变现的政策，那么他的任务可能会更容易处理。如果这样做，从其他土地利益方和银行获得合作——甚至可能是一些财政援助——似乎并非不可能。

股东与存款人
存款人和股东有权获知清算进展和重组细节，但如果由分别代表这两组利益相关方的委员会维持与清算人和受托人的日常联系，事情将会大大简化。在许多情况下，小额存款人显然无力等待有序清算后的收益。如果大额存款人的意见能被听取，他们几乎肯定会倾向于让小额客户得到优待，前提是坚持持有资产以规避立即变现必然导致的贬值的政策能够保全他们自身的利益。清算人需在任命之日起六十天内向法院提交关于美亚集团财务状况的报告。在此期间，该集团及地产公司的存款人和股东最好能组织并选举出代表他们的委员会，并与清算人及受托人保持密切联系。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, JUNE 5, 1935.
10734

A.-O. BANK LIQUIDATION

There will be widespread satisfac-
tion that Judge Milton J. Helmick of
the United States Court for China has
appointed a man of the independent
position occupied by Mr. Frank L.
Hough, Managing Director of the
R. C. A. Victor Company of China, as
liquidator of the American-Oriental
Banking Corporation, the American-
Oriental Finance Corporation, and the
Raven Trust Company, the three Com-
panies which voluntarily suspended
business on May 24. Judge Helmick
has adopted the position ever since the
Companies closed down that the
liquidation has to be carried through
by an able and independent liquidator,
and there can be no shadow of doubt
that Mr. Hough fulfils these qualifica-
tions. He has occupied the position of
the executive head of the R. C. A.
Victor Company for the past two-and-
a-half years and is generally regarded
not only as a sound business executive
but as a man of courage and integrity
—just the kind fully to protect the
interests of depositors, shareholders
and creditors of the three concerns to
be wound up. Judge Helmick has
acted in no hasty manner; he refused
to make a decision while up at
Peiping, and the appointment which he
announced at five o'clock on Monday
afternoon was made only after he had
consulted with many business leaders
of the American community here. In
conjunction with Mr. Hough there will
be working Mr. Felthan Watson, the
U. S. District Attorney, who has been
ordered to make a prompt and search-
ing investigation into the affairs of the
affected concerns, and it is ordered
that the liquidator shall file a report
on the financial position of the Com-
panies within 60 days. Here is evid-
ence that so far as official machinery
can permit there is going to be no
undue delay in discovering the true
position of affairs, and it remains to
express the hope that the public will
be given the benefit of the fullest
possible information at the earliest
possible moment. The powers con-
ferred on the liquidator by the Court
are extremely wide, putting him in
full and undisputed control of all the
affairs of the Companies, and one can
only now await the results of his
labours.

It would seem necessary, however,
to urge upon depositors and others
who are now threatened with the loss
of at least some part of their money
the need for patience. If indications
are to be believed, the liquid cash
position of the A.-O. Bank and the
other two concerns is extremely low.
There are no doubt a large number of
perfectly sound securities and also
other securities which are perhaps not
so sound in the present circumstances
of depressed business, but it is the task
of "collecting the assets of the Com-
panies and reducing such assets to
cash"—to quote the phraseology of
the appointment order—which is going
to be difficult and possibly lengthy.

No-one will realize more keenly than
the liquidator himself the dangers of
seeking hurriedly to realize either
real estate or commercial assets in
these times, and although there is
undoubtedly need to give to depositors
and investors whatever degree of
immediate relief is possible it cannot
be in the best interests of all concern-
ed to rush liquidation through at the
expense of the amount of money
which will be made available for dis-
tribution. That view needs to be
shared by all if liquidation is going to
result in a minimum of loss. It is
known that some of the frozen money
is locked up in industrial undertakings
and that hurriedly to liquidate these
would only cause the extension of the
circle of depression. One has confid-
ence in the official cognizance of that
viewpoint, but it is one which needs to
be appreciated even by those who
have been most hardly hit by the
suspensions. Midway between the
desire to pay out as much as possible
as quickly as possible and the desire
to pay out the greatest possible
amount eventually there is doubtless a
happy mean, and it is to the finding of
that to which Mr. Hough will most
certainly address himself. He takes
on his task with the sincerest goodwill
of the whole community which has
been deeply stirred by the closing down
of three institutions which had enjoy-
ed so much of the community's con-
fidence.

《字林西报》，1935年6月5日，星期三。
10734

美亚银行清算

美国驻华法院的米尔顿·J·赫尔米克（Milton J. Helmick）法官任命了地位独立的 RCA 胜利唱机公司中国分公司总经理弗兰克·L·霍夫（Frank L. Hough）先生，担任美亚银行公司（American-Oriental Banking Corporation）、美亚金融公司（American-Oriental Finance Corporation）和雷文信托公司（Raven Trust Company）的清算人，这三家公司于5月24日自愿停业。对此，人们将感到广泛的满意。自这些公司关闭以来，赫尔米克法官一直持有一种立场，即清算必须由一位能干且独立的清算人来执行，毫无疑问，霍夫先生符合这些资格。在过去两年半的时间里，他一直担任 RCA 胜利唱机公司的行政主管，普遍被认为不仅是一位稳健的商业管理者，而且是一位有勇气和正直的人——这正是充分保护待清理的三家公司存款人、股东和债权人利益所需的那种人。赫尔米克法官行事并不草率；他在北平时拒绝做出决定，直到周一上午五点钟宣布任命之前，他还与此间美国商界的许多领袖进行了磋商。与美国地区检察官费尔森·沃森（Felthan Watson）先生一起工作的还有霍夫先生，后者已受命对受影响公司的业务进行迅速而深入的调查，并命令清算人在60天内提交关于公司财务状况的报告。这里有证据表明，就官方机制所能允许的范围而言，查明事态真相不会出现不当延误，现在只剩下表达希望，即公众能在最早可能的时刻获得尽可能充分的信息的好处。法院赋予清算人的权力极其广泛，使他对公司的所有事务拥有完全且无可争议的控制权，现在人们只能等待他工作的成果。

然而，似乎有必要敦促那些目前面临至少部分资金损失威胁的存款人和其他人保持耐心。如果迹象可信，美亚银行及其他两家公司的现金头寸极低。无疑有大量完全可靠的证券，以及在当前商业萧条的情况下可能不那么可靠的其他证券，但正如任命令中的措辞所述，“收回公司资产并将其变现”的任务将是困难且可能漫长的。

没有人比清算人本人更敏锐地意识到在这个时代急于变现房地产或商业资产的危险，虽然无疑需要向存款人和投资者提供某种程度的即时救济，但以牺牲可分配金额为代价匆忙完成清算，并不符合所有相关方的最佳利益。如果要将清算造成的损失降至最低，所有人都需要认同这一观点。众所周知，部分被冻结的资金被困在工业企业中，匆忙清算这些企业只会扩大萧条的范围。人们对官方认可这一观点有信心，但即使是那些受停业打击最严重的人也需要理解这一点。在尽快支付尽可能多的款项的愿望与最终支付最大可能金额的愿望之间，无疑存在一个理想的平衡点，霍夫先生肯定会致力于寻找这一平衡点。他带着整个社区最真诚的善意承担起了这项任务，社区因三家深受信赖的机构关闭而深感震动。

JUDGE APPOINTS
LIQUIDATOR FOR
RAVEN COMPANIES

Mr. Frank L. Hough to Watch
Depositors Interests

CHOICE MADE AFTER DAY
OF CONFERENCES

The appointment of Mr. Frank L.
Hough, Managing Director of the
R.C.A. Victor Company of China, to
act as liquidator of the American
Oriental Finance Corporation, the
American Oriental Bank Corporation,
and the Raven Trust Company, was
made late yesterday afternoon by
Judge Milton J. Helmick of the U.S.
Court for China.
Announcement of the appointment
was made at 5 p.m. just ten days
and seven hours after the bank closed
its doors following a conference of
the directors of the bank on May 24.
Judge Helmick revealed his selec-
tion after a day's deliberation and
conference in the seclusion of his
chambers with a group which includ-
ed Mr. E. S. Cunningham, American
Consul-General, and Mr. Felthan
Watson, United States District At-
torney in China.
Mr. Hough is expected to qualify as
liquidator to-day and take posses-
sion immediately, according to Judge
Helmick.

Depositors' Good Sought

In an interview with a representa-
tive of the "North-China Daily News"
last night Mr. Hough declared that
he had accepted the appointment in
full accord with Judge Helmick's
views. He said:—
"I intend to do everything I pos-
sibly can to secure the greatest re-
turn for the depositors."
Mr. Hough admitted that he had not
yet been inside the bank and that
an audit must be taken before setting
the wheels in motion.
He stated, however, that it was in
his mind to declare a minimum divi-
dend to the depositors pending the
actual settlement—if there was
sufficient available cash. If possible,
the dividends would be declared im-
mediately.
When the appointment is definitely
confirmed, Mr. Hough intends to open
his offices in the bank premises and
devote his entire time to the bank's
affairs until they are straightened out.

Unknown to Bankers

The R. C. A. Company is a big
organization here and with his gen-
eral supervision from time to time
can carry on during this period, he
stated. Mr. Hough has been in China
for the past two and a half years.
The part of liquidator is no new role
to Mr. Hough, for he served in the
same capacity for a business concern
in the United States some years ago.
Mr. F. J. Raven, president of the
three above companies, when asked
by the "North-China Daily News"
what he thought of the appointment,
revealed that he did not know the
liquidator. Mr. J. Kleffel, vice-pres-
ident and general manager of the
American-Oriental Banking Corpora-
tion, also stated that the liquidator
was unknown to him.
As yet Judge Helmick has taken
no action in appointing a trustee for
the Asia Realty Company.

法官任命
雷文公司清算人

弗兰克·L·霍夫先生将维护
储户利益

经过一天会议后作出选择

昨天下午晚些时候，美国驻华法院法官米尔顿·J·赫尔米克（Milton J. Helmick）任命美商中国无线电唱机公司（R.C.A. Victor Company of China）董事总经理弗兰克·L·霍夫（Frank L. Hough）先生担任美亚金融公司（American Oriental Finance Corporation）、美亚银行公司（American Oriental Bank Corporation）以及雷文信托公司（Raven Trust Company）的清算人。

该项任命的公告于下午5时发布，此时距5月24日银行董事会会议后银行关门停业正好十天零七小时。

赫尔米克法官在密室中与包括美国总领事E.S.坎宁安（E. S. Cunningham）先生和美国驻华地区检察官费尔森·沃森（Felthan Watson）先生在内的一组人士进行了一天的审议和磋商后，公布了他的选择。

据赫尔米克法官称，霍夫先生预计将于今日取得任职资格并立即接管。

谋求储户利益

霍夫先生昨晚在接受《字林西报》记者采访时宣称，他接受这项任命是完全符合赫尔米克法官的观点的。他说：—
“我打算尽我所能，为储户争取最大的回报。”
霍夫先生承认，他尚未进入银行内部，且在启动工作之前必须进行审计。
然而，他表示，如果现有现金充足，他考虑在实际结算之前向储户宣布发放最低限度的股息。如果可能，股息将立即宣布。
一旦任命正式确认，霍夫先生打算在银行办公场所开设他的办公室，并将全部时间投入到银行事务中，直到事务理顺为止。

银行家们不知情

霍夫先生表示，R.C.A.公司在沪是一家大型机构，在此期间他可以不时地进行总体监督。霍夫先生在过去两年半里一直在中国。
担任清算人对霍夫先生来说并非新角色，因为几年前他曾在美国的一家商业机构中担任过同样的职务。
当《字林西报》询问上述三家公司总裁F.J.雷文（F. J. Raven）先生对此次任命有何看法时，他表示不认识这位清算人。美亚银行公司副总裁兼总经理J.克莱费尔（J. Kleffel）先生也表示，他不认识这位清算人。
截至目前，赫尔米克法官尚未采取行动任命亚洲地产公司（Asia Realty Company）的受托人。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, JUNE 4, 1935

“A CASUALTY”
Delay Deprecated

To the Editor of the
“NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS”
SIR,—Kindly grant me some space
in your valuable paper to endorse
completely “BRITISH SHAREHOLDER’S”
suggestion that some form of protec-
tion to the shareholders of the
American-Oriental Group should be
initiated without delay. The Re-
ceivership granted to the A.O.F.C.
branch office at Manlia makes the
protection more imminent since
liquidation is already in process, or
about to proceed.
With due respect to the depositors,
I think the unfortunate stockholders
facing such a great catastrophe
through no fault of their own, deserve
equal if not more sympathy.
As each of the four American-
Oriental Group has more than four
million dollars paid-up capital, the
number of common and preferred
stockholders must be tremendous.
Their interest, without doubt, deserves
no less attention.
In view of the enormous number
of investors that are being affected, it
is hoped some local organization such
as the Shanghai Stock Exchange will
come forward and initiate a form
of protective society and look after
the shareholders’ interest so that in-
vestors of local shares will not lose
their confidence in future. Alterna-
tively some A.-O. shareholders in the
legal profession perhaps may take
the lead and charge at a lowest
possible fixed rate for the service
from the co-sufferers.
“ANOTHER VICTIM.”
Shanghai, June 3.

《字林西报》，1935年6月4日，星期二

“一名受害者”
谴责延误

致《字林西报》编辑
先生，—恳请贵报赐予版面，让我完全支持“英国股东”提出的建议，即应立即着手为美亚集团股东提供某种形式的保护。鉴于马尼拉美亚金融公司分支机构已被授予接管令，且清算工作已经在进行中或即将开始，这种保护显得更为紧迫。
出于对储户的尊重，我认为那些非因自身过错而面临如此巨大灾难的不幸股东，值得获得同等、甚至更多的同情。
由于美亚集团旗下的四家公司每一家的实缴资本都超过四百万元，普通股和优先股股东的数量必然庞大。毫无疑问，他们的利益值得给予同样的关注。
鉴于受影响的投资者人数众多，希望上海股票交易所等本地组织能够挺身而出，发起成立一种保护性社团，照管股东利益，从而使本地股票的投资者在未来不会失去信心。或者，法律界的一些美亚股东或许可以牵头，以尽可能低的固定费率向难友提供服务并收取费用。
“另一名受害者。”
上海，6月3日。

page_data.en:
Some Reflections
To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"
SIR.—The collapse of a few native
banks and the fate of the American-
Oriental group are painful symptoms
of the disease affecting the body
economic.
There is a general feeling of un-
easiness among the public that those
who have the power to act, faced
with, admittedly, grave responsibili-
ties, prefer to await developments, or,
in other words, to allow the malady
to progress unchecked until the
inevitable crisis occurs and drastic
action can no longer be deferred.
But the longer action is delayed
the greater will be the crisis when
it comes and the more acute the
problems to be solved.
There is a tendency in certain
quarters to leave the control of cur-
rency and finance in the hands of
bankers who are naturally regarded
as specialists in these matters. But
it must not be forgotten that the in-
terests of bankers and traders at
times conflict, and if the voices of
the latter are not heard it will not
be surprising if, in searching for a
way of escape from our difficulties,
the views of the purely financial in-
terests prevail. It was the influence
of "The City" it will be remembered,
that was largely responsible for Great
Britain's premature return to the
gold standard after the war. Broadly
speaking, the Banks represent the
creditor element and are naturally
upholders of "a sound currency" in-
flationist theories are anathema to
them. The Producer on the other
hand, confronted with the problems
of the debtor, is painfully aware that
a currency appreciating in value
makes it impossible for him to oper-
ate his plant at a profit. The supreme
desideratum is, of course, a stable
currency, a currency that in terms
of commodities remains constant and
maintains the conflicting interests of
creditor and debtor balanced.
In Shanghai we have now neither
a sound currency nor a stable one.
While the present uncertainty over-
hanging the future of the dollar
remains business will languish and
we will proceed steadily down the
road leading to insolvency. There is
nothing so paralysing as uncertainty.
The present policy of those in control
of currency matters betrays their
hesitation. It appears to be an at-
tempt to retain the solid virtues of a
silver standard without suffering the
inevitable consequences of the re-
morseless rise in the value of the
metal. Such an impossible com-
promise must of necessity fail, the
issue cannot be evaded much longer.
Silver must eventually find its own
level, a higher external value will
draw it out of the country. Export
taxes and embargoes can do no more
than check the outflow, they cannot
stop it. It can only be a question of
time when the supply of silver has
shrunk to a point at which it will no
longer be possible to sustain the
dollar nominally on a convertible
basis and China will be driven off
silver. Is it not better to tackle these
problems now and devise a dollar
that will not be at the mercy of
silver manipulators across the water?
A managed currency may breed
alarm in many quarters but these
fears can be allayed if evidence is
produced showing that the necessary
backing for a fiduciary note issue is
forthcoming.
QUAESTOR.
Shanghai, June 3.
page_data.zh:
一些思考
致《字林西报》编辑
先生，—几家华资银行的倒闭以及美亚集团的命运，是经济机体患病带来的痛苦症状。
公众普遍感到不安，认为那些有权采取行动的人，面对 admittedly 严峻的责任，却宁愿等待事态发展，或者说，任由病情 unchecked 地恶化，直到不可避免的危机发生，不得不采取严厉措施时为止。
但是，行动拖延得越久，危机到来时就越大，需要解决的问题也就越尖锐。
某些方面倾向于将货币和金融的控制权留在银行家手中，因为他们自然被视为这些领域的专家。但不可忽视的是，银行家和商人的利益有时会发生冲突，如果听不到后者的声音，那么在寻求摆脱困境的途径时，纯粹金融利益的观点占据上风也就不足为奇了。人们记得，正是“伦敦金融城”的影响，在很大程度上导致了英国在战后过早地恢复金本位制。 broadly speaking，银行代表债权人一方，自然是“健全货币”的拥护者，通货膨胀理论为他们所深恶痛绝。另一方面，生产者面对债务人的问题，痛苦地意识到货币升值使他无法盈利地运营其工厂。当然，最高的愿望是拥有稳定的货币，即一种以商品衡量保持恒定、并能平衡债权人和债务人相互冲突利益的货币。
在上海，我们既没有健全的货币，也没有稳定的货币。只要美元前景的不确定性依然存在，商业就会萧条，我们将稳步走向破产的道路。没有什么比不确定性更令人瘫痪的了。
目前掌控货币事务者的政策暴露了他们的犹豫。这似乎是一种试图保留银本位的坚实优点，而不承受金属价值无情上涨所带来的不可避免后果的尝试。这种不可能的妥协必然失败，这个问题不能再回避太久。白银最终会找到其自身的水平，较高的外部价值会将其引出国外。出口税和禁令只能遏制外流，而不能阻止外流。白银供应缩减到无法再名义上维持美元可兑换基础的那一刻，只是时间问题，中国将被迫放弃银本位。现在着手解决这些问题，并设计一种不受大洋彼岸白银操纵者摆布的美元，难道不是更好吗？
管理货币可能在许多方面引起恐慌，但如果能拿出证据表明必要的信用纸币发行 backing 已经到位，这些恐惧是可以消除的。
QUAESTOR。
上海，6月3日。
